Step 1: Sydney is UTC+10 (historical time zones approximated; in 1784 likely LMT ~UTC+10).  
Step 2: Athens is UTC+2 (LMT ~UTC+02:00).  
Step 3: Time difference = Athens − Sydney = 2 − 10 = −8 hours.  
Step 4: 11:00 Sydney − 8 hours = 03:00 same day (June 10, 1784) in Athens.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1784-06-10 03:00
